items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: If I know he's there and I see him, I say, 'Oh, no, no, I can't play with him.'

ctx.x: If I know he's there and I see him, I say, "Oh, no, no, I can't play with him. Get somebody else, I don't make the gig, just like that. And everybody's looking, "What's wrong
with him? Looky at there, he can't play with him? As good a bass player as George Davivier? " And we still carry on like that.
